scripts.build: npm run build -w @aviaratech/ai-memory && npm run build -w @aviaratech/ai-memory-tools && npm run build -w @aviaratech/ai-memory-plugin
scripts.checks: npm run format:check && npm run build && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test
scripts.format: oxfmt packages plugins package.json vitest.config.ts vitest.integration.config.ts .oxlintrc.json .oxfmtrc.json tsconfig.base.json tsconfig.scripts.json
scripts.format:check: oxfmt --check packages plugins package.json vitest.config.ts vitest.integration.config.ts .oxlintrc.json .oxfmtrc.json tsconfig.base.json tsconfig.scripts.json
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @aviaratech/ai-memory && npm run typecheck -w @aviaratech/ai-memory-tools && tsc -p tsconfig.scripts.json
